title: rhodiola subpinnata
intro: Rhodiola subpinnata, commonly known as Arctic Rhodiola, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Crassulaceae family. It is native to the high-altitude regions of the Himalayas and is traditionally used to enhance physical and mental performance, making it a valuable adaptogen. The health benefits of Rhodiola subpinnata include reducing stress and anxiety, improving mood, and enhancing cognitive function, which is attributed to its therapeutic actions of adaptogenic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Rhodiola subpinnata include rosmarinic acid, rosavin, and salidroside, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
